title: Ransomware Affiliate Sentenced to 70 Months
excerpt: A Ukrainian national received a 70-month prison sentence for participating in Nefilim and Hive ransomware attacks against organizations worldwide.
body_html:
A Ukrainian national has been sentenced to 70 months in prison for involvement in ransomware attacks against high-revenue businesses, government entities, and hospitals globally. The criminal activity took place between 2018 and 2021.

According to the details, the individual operated as an affiliate for both the Nefilim and Hive ransomware strains. The attacks targeted organizations worldwide, causing significant disruptions before law enforcement action was taken against the participants involved in these operations.
